confirmation_rule.procedure: Independently reconstruct the six development selectors on the confirmation view, summarize both sets of six banks, and compare the six-bank ordering for every summary coordinate.
confirmation_rule.rank_statistic: Spearman correlation with average ranks for ties
confirmation_rule.aggregate_gate: Every finite nonconstant summary coordinate must pass. A coordinate that is constant in both views is recorded as stable with correlation 1.0; a coordinate constant in only one view fails.
confirmation_rule.failure_action: abstain before freezing candidate memberships or version a new protocol
